Here are the official Vite migration guides on vitejs.dev (by target Vite major):

1) Migration from v2 (Vite v3 docs). [1]. ([v3.vitejs.dev](https://v3.vitejs.dev/guide/migration.html?utm_source=openai))

- 2: https://v4.vitejs.dev/guide/migration.html?utm_source=openai

Text says "upgrading to Vite 5" but link points to v6.vite.dev, which documents upgrading to Vite 6. Either change the text to "upgrading to Vite 6" (keeping the v6 link) or change the link to `https://v5.vite.dev/guide/migration.html` (keeping "Vite 5").

Vite 6" to match the existing https://v6.vite.dev/guide/migration link, or
replace the link with https://v5.vite.dev/guide/migration.html if you intend to

Use the Next.js helper exported from the next/jest package. Example from the official docs:

import type { Config } from 'jest'

const createJestConfig = nextJest({ dir: './' })

  coverageProvider: 'v8',
  testEnvironment: 'jsdom',
  // setupFilesAfterEnv: ['<rootDir>/jest.setup.ts'],
}

Official Next.js documentation (Jest guide). [1][2]

Sources:
[1] Next.js — Testing: Jest (app/docs).  
[2] Next.js — How to set up Jest (pages/docs).

---

```diff
-const nextJest = require('next/jest.js');
+const nextJest = require('next/jest');
```
